children: One tool version, one production/example syntax, five compile/sim pairs, ten negative elaborations; every child <=20 seconds

all legal handles and high invalid full32-bit handles
protocol: preoffered INTERN data blocked before LOAD
four-cycle output hold on every token

reset: Immediate observed-boundary reset in all fifteen reachable states (INCREMENT unreachable when REF_W=1), CLEAR mid-sweep, copy partial write, READ partial replay and held ACK/READ with preoffered next command; each followed by empty check, allocation, duplicate/saturation, complete readback, release, reuse, neighbor preservation when available, clear and missing read.
